newsitem.title: USA: HP unveils heavy duty Unix servers.
newsitem.headline: HP unveils heavy duty Unix servers.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co. Thursday introduced its next generation of high performance servers that are aimed at intensive transaction processing.
The V-Class Enterprise Servers will be available in volume in the fourth quarter. The price of HP's V2200 model starts at $170,000 for a base system.

HP also introduced its K-Class enterprise servers, designed mainly to run Web applications, database, local area networks and file management. The K-Series is available in mid-summer, starting at $66,900.
HP's stock rose 87.5 cents to $54.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
